hooks.name: prodeng-doctor
hooks.command: p=$(for c in "${PRODENG_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/plugins/prodeng" "${HOME:-}/.agents/plugins/prodeng" "${HOME:-}/.openhands/plugins/installed/prodeng"; do [ -f "$c/hooks/scripts/prodeng_doctor.py" ] && printf %s "$c" && break; done); [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "prodeng plugin root unresolved" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python3 "$p/hooks/scripts/prodeng_doctor.py"
